title: Attachment
description: Base resource for file, item, and reference attachments. Use the @odata.type property to specify the derived type.

@odata.type.description: The OData type of the attachment. Use #microsoft.graph.fileAttachment for file attachments or #microsoft.graph.itemAttachment for item attachments.

id.description: The unique identifier of the attachment. Read-only.

name.description: The display name of the attachment.

contentType.description: The MIME type of the attachment.

size.description: The length of the attachment in bytes.

isInline.description: True if the attachment is an inline attachment.

lastModifiedDateTime.description: The date and time the attachment was last modified in UTC.

contentBytes.description: The base64-encoded contents of the file. Only applicable for fileAttachment.

contentId.description: The ID of the attachment in the Exchange store. Only applicable for fileAttachment.

contentLocation.description: The Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) corresponding to the location of the content of the attachment.
